properties.title: SHHEIKH

identifier.value: Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) Decentralized Finance (DeFi) Companies

overview_description.description: Shheikh is a blockchain and AI-driven investment platform that enables users to access fractional ownership of high-value real-world assets (RWAs), including luxury real estate, premium vehicles, farmland, and collectibles. Built on Ethereum, the platform combines decentralized finance (DeFi), AI-powered asset intelligence, and smart contract automation to simplify global investment opportunities for retail and crypto investors. The platform’s ecosystem revolves around the SHHEIKH token, which is designed to provide investors with access to tokenized assets, passive income opportunities, governance participation, and automated yield distribution. Shheikh also promotes cross-border accessibility by lowering investment entry barriers through blockchain technology and fractional asset ownership. Features highlighted by the platform include AI-based yield analysis, automated KYC/AML processes, DeFi integration, and support for multiple digital wallets.
